alloy.preparation: High-purity elements vacuum arc-melted and cast as buttons; homogenized 2 h at 1250°C, hot-rolled to 5-mm plates, cold-rolled to 2-mm sheets, solution-annealed 20 min at 1050°C and water-quenched.

test_solution.preparation: Deaerated by high-purity nitrogen purging from 1 h before testing and throughout the test.

test_method.procedure_description: ASTM G5 cell: 1-L multinecked flask, platinum counter electrode and SCE in a salt bridge with a high-silica tip. Begin anodic polarization after stable corrosion potential, usually about 2 h after immersion; three or four tests per alloy in the Figure 3/4 population. All potentials referred to SCE.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Potential at which anodic current density reaches 10 µA/cm² after film breakdown.

experiments.result_note: Discrete repeated measurements; individual run numbers are not printed. Pitting criterion: anodic current density 10 µA/cm² after breakdown. Figure 4 re-expresses the Figure 3 population on an atomic-percent axis; fitted lines do not create observations. Two stacked base-alloy markers are separable; fully hidden repeats cannot be enumerated. Composition is the Table 1 chemical analysis in wt%, including Fe explicitly printed as balance. Atomic-percent plot coordinates do not replace this analysis. The separate 20% H2SO4/30°C passivation tests are excluded from the pitting context.

experiments.result_note: Single plotted composition-level result. The paper does not define it explicitly as a replicate mean. The 4W / 4Mo points may summarize the respective Fig. 3–4 populations (obs_018–020 / obs_009–012), but no run/aggregation identity is established; retained separately, not asserted independent experiments. Composition is the Table 1 chemical analysis in wt%, including Fe explicitly printed as balance. Atomic-percent plot coordinates do not replace this analysis. The separate 20% H2SO4/30°C passivation tests are excluded from the pitting context.

alloy.preparation: High-purity elements vacuum arc-melted and cast as buttons; homogenized 2 h at 1250°C, hot-rolled to 5-mm plates, cold-rolled to 2-mm sheets, solution-annealed 20 min at 1050°C and water-quenched.

test_solution.preparation: Deaerated by high-purity nitrogen purging from 1 h before testing and throughout the test.

test_method.procedure_description: ASTM G5 cell: 1-L multinecked flask, platinum counter electrode and SCE in a salt bridge with a high-silica tip. Begin anodic polarization after stable corrosion potential, usually about 2 h after immersion; three or four tests per alloy in the Figure 3/4 population. All potentials referred to SCE.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Potential at which anodic current density reaches 10 µA/cm² after film breakdown.
